hebrewText: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥/י לִ/שְׁקֹ֣ד עַל דַּ֭לְתֹתַ/י י֤וֹם י֑וֹם לִ֝/שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽ/י

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)

tokens.bdb: to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill)
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
